text: Cycling is an ancient form of transportation that utilizes a bicycle as its primary mode of mobility. Tires play a pivotal role in this sport, providing the necessary traction and support to the rider while they are in motion. As the rider pedals forward, the tire's contact patch with the road surface ensures that the bike remains stable and controlled. On the other hand, the brakes are crucial in maintaining control while cycling. When the brake pedal is pressed, it applies pressure on the brake drum, which subsequently slows down the wheels, allowing the rider to stop the bike. Regular maintenance of both the tires and brakes is vital in avoiding accidents and ensuring the overall health of the bike.
